question: Will the “Seeds of Possibility” mentioned by Roswaal in Re:Zero -Lost in Memories - ever be addressed in the future?
answer:
I'm not sure how much we'll touch upon the “Seeds of Possibility,” but we're planning to delve into characters such as the “Illusionist,” who appeared in Re:Zero - Lost in Memories - , through the short stories.

I want to give proper conclusions to things that couldn't be covered in Re:Zero - Lost in Memories -, so please look forward to seeing what happens with them!
